annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de Justicia, Presidencia de la Nación (Argentina)
key_provisions_or_claims: UNESCO 2021 Recommendation, adopted by 193 states including Argentina, stresses human supervision of AI systems.
Argentina issued 2023 Recommendations for Trustworthy AI promoting transparent, equitable, common-good AI.
Guidelines require data and models to be transparent, explainable and auditable.
Misuse of AI may aggravate disinformation, deepfakes, cybercrime, bias and the digital divide.
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Argentine Ministry of Justice public-awareness web page explaining AI ethics. It cites the UNESCO 2021 Recommendation's emphasis on human supervision and Argentina's 2023 Recommendations for Trustworthy AI, stressing transparent, explainable, auditable and equitable AI. No robotics content.
annotation.title_clean: La supervisión humana aporta ética a la Inteligencia Artificial
annotation.title_en: Human oversight brings ethics to Artificial Intelligence
annotation.venue: argentina.gob.ar – Con Vos en la Web
